ticket: Let a task's creator make it private so only its assignee can see it.
notes: can_view_task says every active user sees every task and there are no private tasks. Admin visibility, listing/search leaks, and mentions are open.

criticalAmbiguities.description: Whether admins (and the creator) can still see private tasks.
search, listings, comments and mentions can leak private tasks.
Existing tasks and what happens when the assignee changes.

expectedContradictions.description: can_view_task documents that all active users see all tasks.

unacceptableAssumptions.description: Silently hiding private tasks from admins.
